## The Bachelor of Actuarial Studies at ANU

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%" .compact}
- Details can be found [here](https://programsandcourses.anu.edu.au/program/BACTS).
- Entry requirements (2026):
  - ATAR = 92
  - Mathematics = Specialist (major, required) / Specialist (major/minor, recommended)
- ANU provides for potential [exemption](https://cbe.anu.edu.au/about/professional-organisations-and-accreditation/actuaries-institute-requirements) from the Foundation Program and half of the Actuary Program in Australia.
- Centre of Actuarial Excellence and opportunity for University Earned Credit with the Society of Actuaries.
:::
::: {.column width="42%"}

:::

## Industry experts

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%" .compact}
- Our programs are designed with a primary goal to prepare you for the practical work of an actuary.
- Most of the actuarial staff have worked commercially before coming to academia – we know what is involved to prepare you for working life and future exams, and we prepare students for that.
- Feedback from employers about our graduates is excellent – ANU actuarial graduates are seen to be of a very high quality.
:::
::: {.column width="42%"}
![](images/anu-classroom.png){.photo fig-alt="A small ANU class in discussion around a table"}
:::
::::

## Academic Foundation

::: {.pillars}
::: {.pillar}
**Research-led teaching**

Teachers are active researchers publishing in top-tier journals, bringing the latest thinking into classrooms. Each course is taught by experts in their fields, drawing on a wealth of academics across many disciplines.
:::
::: {.pillar}
**Flexibility on most programs**

Pick and choose electives, minors and even majors.
:::
::: {.pillar}
**Teaching innovations**

Interactive lecture slides, oral assessment, group projects, and integrating AI in the classroom.
:::
:::

## Practical Skill

::: {.pillars}
::: {.pillar}
**Industry recognitions**

Programs are well-structured with recognition by 12 professional bodies (AUS, U.S. and internationals).
:::
::: {.pillar}
**Communication skills\***

Group work, presentation, report writing and more.
:::
::: {.pillar}
**Technical skills\***

Programming and working alongside AI.
:::
::: {.pillar}
**Extra Opportunities**

Work-integrated programs, real-world case study competitions, managing real-world funds (A\$900,000), and professional qualifications.
:::
:::

[\*Exposure to these skills vary by program and course.]{.source-line}
